description: Procedures for revoking access upon personnel termination are not defined or followed. This signal indicates that former employees or contractors may retain access to systems after separation.
applicability: Applicable to all personnel access management. Includes termination checklists, access revocation procedures, and property retrieval processes for departing personnel.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through termination process review, orphaned account discovery, and access revocation timeliness verification.
